items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: And he left Jap Allen's orchestra to travel with us.

ctx.x: And I am sure, that they could have been much better, because they had men like Buster Bailey, and Buster was a great man, great musician, great -- very great clarinet player and musician. And it was just one of those things, I guess, but I don't know.
Well, those guys drank -- did an awful lot of drinking in that band too, that may have been part of it.
